name: Gahat Ki Dal
instructions: 1. Soak the Gahat dal overnight and drain. 2. Pressure cook the soaked dal with water, salt, and turmeric for 6-8 whistles until soft. 3. Mash a small portion of the cooked dal to thicken the consistency. 4. Heat mustard oil in a pan until smoking, then add cumin seeds, dry red chilies, and asafoetida. 5. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until golden. 6. Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer for 5 minutes. 7. Garnish with fresh coriander before serving with steamed rice or mandua roti.
description: Gahat Ki Dal, or Horse Gram dal, is a staple superfood from the hills of Uttarakhand. Known for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating kidney stones and promoting overall health, this dish is a quintessential comfort food in Kumaoni and Garhwali cuisine, traditionally cooked in iron vessels.
